name: magenxcommerce/module-ai-mcp
description: Serves a Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint from Magento so an AI agent such as Claude Code can inspect and manage the backend: products, categories, orders, invoices, shipments, credit memos, customers, stock, tier prices, cart and catalog price rules, CMS content, store configuration, cache and indexers. Authenticated with a Magento Integration access token and authorized against that integration's own ACL role; disabled by default, writes opt-in.
